items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: Do you know Mezzrow? ... Yeah, Mezzrow and Joe Glaser.

ctx.x: Had had that demonstrations. So everything was tight then, segregated, you see. So they didn't allow the blacks and the whites to be on the stage together. So therefore the show had to go South and they had to dump us. So here's what happened. Then I think -- I believe Louis contacted -- either Louis -- yeah, Louis contacted me. That was two people were trying to be the manager for Louis. Do you know Mezzrow?
